mappings.mathWorksBlock: PID Controller and Discrete PID Controller
mappings.supportedSubset: Parallel form with P, I, D, filtered derivative coefficient N, continuous time, and explicit or inherited-sample-time discrete Forward Euler integration and filtering. P, I, PI, PD, and PID behavior is selected by zeroing inactive gains.
intentionalDeviations: Process Lab exposes one parallel-form block instead of separate controller type and form menus.
Process Lab retains an explicit 0.1 second default for new discrete controllers; inherited rate is opt-in.
Ideal form, unfiltered derivative, saturation, anti-windup, reset, tracking, and external coefficient ports are outside this subset.

mappings.mathWorksBlock: PID Controller (2DOF) and Discrete PID Controller (2DOF)
mappings.supportedSubset: Parallel 2DOF PID with proportional setpoint weight b, derivative setpoint weight c, filtered derivative coefficient N, explicit or inherited discrete sample time, and explicit reference and measurement inputs.
intentionalDeviations: Process Lab exposes one parallel-form block and selects PI, PD, or PID behavior by zeroing inactive gains.
Ideal form, unfiltered derivative, saturation, anti-windup, reset, tracking, and external coefficient ports are outside this subset.
